items.title: Pic of X is the Galois-invariant Pic of X_{k'}

items.difficulty_reason: Prove Pic(X) = Pic(X_{k'})^{Gal(k'/k)} with continuous action for a Galois extension k'/k when X is qcqs with H^0 = k and a k-rational point: for infinite k' write k' = colim k'_lambda finite Galois, Pic(X_{k'}) = colim Pic(X_{k_lambda}) by limits-lemma-descend-invertible-modules with injective transitions (varieties-lemma-change-fields-pic), giving continuity of the action and reduction to the finite case; for finite G pick for each sigma an isomorphism phi_sigma : L -> f_sigma^*L; use the k-rational point x (fixed point x' in X_{k'}) to normalize: choose a nonzero s in the fibre L_{x'} and scale each phi_sigma to send s to f_sigma^*s; then phi_{sigma tau} and f_sigma^* phi_tau circ phi_sigma both send s to f_{sigma tau}^*s and differ by a global unit of X_{k'} which is k' (H^0 = k'), so they agree; Galois descent gives the descended sheaf.
